nodes.title: 0.3.1: PM GUI shows orchestration and worktree state, built in parallel with M16

acceptance: human: the maintainer has approved the information design in this sheet (the drawer, the leaf detail and the outline badge: which fields, in what order, which show first, how unknown and missing values look) or recorded the changes in this sheet before M17.2 starts

human: the maintainer has confirmed that M17 is read-only in 0.3.1 (no GUI action stops or messages a worker, prunes a worktree, releases a claim or records a review), or named the one mutating action wanted, which the planner then files as its own M17 leaf that calls the CLI's existing command
nodes.title: Gate: maintainer signs off the orchestration panels' information design and the read-only scope for 0.3.1

acceptance: gui/pm-gantt/src/orchestrationSnapshot.ts declares the snapshot type: its required fields are exactly M16.3.1's v1 list (schema; per leaf key the claim {codename, branch, registered_at}, workers {id, harness, model, status, pid_alive, started_at, ended_at}, worktrees {path, branch, dirty} and reviews {model, verdict, commit, fresh_for_head}; leafless workers) with status in claimed, running, exited_ok, exited_failed, abandoned, unknown; the schema 2 additions are optional fields (worker account, last_activity, flags; worktree ahead, behind; per leaf ready {commit, model, at}, gate {state, approvals, blocks, fresh_for_head}, holds) and this sheet lists them for M17.6

gui/pm-gantt/src/fixtures/orchestration_snapshot_mock.json covers every status value, a leaf with two worktrees, a leafless worker, an `unknown` field, a stale review (fresh_for_head false), a READY with a blocking review, a held leaf and a worker flagged stalled and steering_changed; a vitest test fails when the mock has a key the type does not declare or lacks a required one

A pure view model in the same module (no React, no fetch) groups leaves in outline id order then leafless workers, picks one leaf badge with the precedence in M17.1's sheet, formats ages from an injected clock, and renders `unknown` as "unknown" and an absent optional field as "—", never as false, 0 or clean; table-driven vitest tests over the mock cover each rule
No component, route or existing type changes; `cd gui/pm-gantt && npm ci && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build` passes
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): frontend about +350 (module, tests and mock)
nodes.title: PM GUI: orchestration snapshot types, a mock snapshot and a pure view model, tested against the mock

acceptance: A header button "Orchestration" opens a read-only drawer: one group per leaf with orchestration state in outline order (display id, title, leaf badge, claim codename, branch and registered age), then a "No leaf" group; each worker row shows id, harness / model, account, status, last activity age, started / ended and flag badges (failed, stalled, steering_changed, any other flag verbatim), all from M17.2's view model

api.ts gains `fetchOrchestration()` for `GET /api/orchestration`; when the server answers 404 the drawer says the server does not provide the orchestration snapshot yet; the mock renders only in a dev build (`import.meta.env.DEV`) with `?mock=orchestration`; no existing request in api.ts changes

Clicking a leaf id opens the existing edit modal for that node; clicking a worker opens the existing Workers drawer on that worker; the drawer reloads on open and on Refresh and adds no polling interval; it issues only GET requests (a vitest test or a tests/ grep asserts OrchestrationDrawer imports no mutation helper)
App.tsx grows only by the button, the open state and the lazy mount (under 30 lines); `cd gui/pm-gantt && npm ci && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build` passes
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): frontend about +250
nodes.title: PM GUI: a read-only Orchestration drawer lists workers per leaf with state, harness and model, account, last activity and flags

acceptance: LeafOrchestrationDetail shows for one leaf: the claim; each worktree (path, branch, dirty yes / no / unknown, ahead and behind the integration branch or "—"); the newest READY (short commit, model, age); each review record (model, verdict, commit, fresh for HEAD); the gate summary (state, approvals, blocks, fresh for HEAD); and holds (gate ids the leaf waits on)

A review whose fresh_for_head is false, or whose commit differs from the READY commit, is marked stale; blocking verdicts list first; fields a schema 1 server omits show "—"; view-model tests cover each rule

The detail shows in the Orchestration drawer for a selected leaf and as a collapsed read-only "Orchestration" section in the existing edit modal for leaf nodes; the edit modal's save paths and their tests are unchanged
`cd gui/pm-gantt && npm ci && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build` passes
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): frontend about +250
nodes.title: PM GUI: per-leaf orchestration detail shows worktrees with dirty and ahead/behind, the READY commit, review verdicts with fresh-for-head, and the gate state

acceptance: When the snapshot is available each leaf row shows at most one badge chosen by the view model (blocked / held, exited_failed, stalled, running, READY awaiting review, approved, claimed, abandoned, unknown), with a hover listing claim, workers, worktree count, READY and review summary; a row with no orchestration state shows nothing new
A held leaf's hover names the gate ids from the snapshot's holds ("—" when the server sends none); a leaf with a blocking review or a READY `blocked_on` shows "blocked" with the count

Clicking the badge opens the Orchestration drawer filtered to that leaf; the snapshot loads once per roadmap refresh with no new polling interval; when `GET /api/orchestration` answers 404 the outline renders exactly as before (existing outline and gantt tests unchanged)
App.tsx grows by under 20 lines; `cd gui/pm-gantt && npm ci && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build` passes
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): frontend about +150
nodes.title: PM GUI: the outline shows one orchestration badge per leaf for claims, holds, running or failed workers and review state, linking into the drawer

acceptance: `orchestration.state.snapshot(repo_root)` returns `schema: 2`: every v1 field keeps its name, type and value; it adds per worker `account` (the record's billing route or roster account label, else null), `last_activity` (the newer of the last event time and last_output_at) and `flags`; per worktree `ahead` and `behind` against the local integration ref; per leaf `ready` {commit, model, at} from the newest valid READY for the registered branch, `gate` {state, approvals, blocks, fresh_for_head} and `holds` (open gate ids the leaf depends on, as list-gates reports); tests/fixtures/orchestration_snapshot_v2.json lists exactly these fields and they equal the optional fields of gui/pm-gantt/src/orchestrationSnapshot.ts

The builder stays read-only: it writes nothing, runs no stall sweep, ack or fetch, and uses local refs only; an unreadable source sets only its own fields to `unknown` (tests: an unreadable READY, a missing integration ref, a corrupt worker record)

The gate summary calls the review gate's existing public function rather than re-implementing it, and the layering gate stays green; `worker list`, `orchestrate plan` and doctor output are unchanged (M16.3.1's parity rows stay green); docs/orchestration.md documents schema 2
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): package about +150, tests about +200
nodes.title: Orchestration snapshot schema 2: optional fields for the PM GUI (worker account, last activity and flags; worktree ahead/behind; READY, gate summary and holds per leaf)

acceptance: `GET /api/orchestration` returns `orchestration.state.snapshot(repo_root)` for the main worktree (like `/api/workers`) plus the display id for each leaf key; the handler imports only `specy_road.orchestration` (the layering gate stays green) and lives in the gui_app module M16.3.7 folded

It works under `specy-road gui --read-only`; every existing `/api/` route keeps its response shape (existing GUI tests unchanged, including tests/test_gui_outline_contract.py and tests/test_gui_app_workers.py); this is the only route added

A contract test fails when the response's keys differ from tests/fixtures/orchestration_snapshot_v2.json, or when gui/pm-gantt/src/fixtures/orchestration_snapshot_mock.json has a key the fixture lacks or lacks a required one
Tests over fixture repos: no orchestration state (200, empty), a claim with a running worker and a READY, an unreadable worker record (200, that worker's fields `unknown`)
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): package about +40, tests about +150
nodes.title: PM GUI server: GET /api/orchestration serves the snapshot read-only, with contract tests tying the server fixture and the GUI mock together

acceptance: docs/pm-gui.md gains an "Orchestration drawer" entry under What ships (panels, each field's meaning, the unknown / "—" rule, badge precedence, read-only) and a `/orchestration` row in the read-only JSON API table; docs/pm-workflow.md gains one paragraph on reading it; tests/test_docs_links.py passes
CHANGELOG.md's [Unreleased] Added lists the drawer, the leaf detail, the outline badge and `GET /api/orchestration`; no version heading, no project.version change, no tag

Against `specy-road gui` on a fixture repo with live orchestration state the drawer shows the server's snapshot, not the mock; a test (or a grep of the production build output) shows the production bundle cannot render the mock
`cd gui/pm-gantt && npm ci && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build` passes; validate, export --check and file-limits pass
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): docs about +60, frontend small
nodes.title: PM GUI orchestration view: docs/pm-gui.md and pm-workflow.md sections, the API table row, the CHANGELOG entry and a live check against the real route

acceptance: Run by the coordinator, not CI and not a worker: before the first sandbox call the coordinator asks the maintainer and records the approval (date) in tests/sandbox/pm_gui_orchestration/RESULTS.md

tests/sandbox/pm_gui_orchestration/ holds a setup script that builds the wheel (after `npm run build`), creates a fixture repo from tests/fixtures/specy_road_dogfood seeded with orchestration state (a claim with a running worker, a failed worker flagged stalled, a leaf with two worktrees one dirty, a READY with one approving and one stale review, a held leaf, a leafless worker) and starts `specy-road gui --read-only`; a browser test script for sbvm_run_browser_test; and CHECKLIST.md

The run uses the sandbox MCP tools (claim_workspace, vm_start, sbvm_exec to install the wheel and run setup, sbvm_run_browser_test, sbvm_screenshot) and covers each checklist item: drawer groups and flags, leaf detail (stale review, ahead/behind, holds), outline badge and its link, the 404 message against a server without the route, and a refused POST under --read-only

RESULTS.md records date, wheel version and commit, VM image, pass / fail per checklist item and screenshot names (screenshots stay under work/, gitignored); each defect is filed as a new M17 leaf (so the M16.8.9 gate waits for it), not fixed in this leaf
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): tests/sandbox about +250; package 0
nodes.title: GUI acceptance on the agentic sandbox: a scripted browser run of the orchestration view against a built wheel and a seeded fixture repo, with a checklist and recorded results
